settings.title: From chaos to
settings.intro: We don't just record transactions. We connect your bank, invoices, and expenses into one living ledger that reconciles itself — so you can trust the numbers without the busywork.

features.title: Auto-reconciliation
features.text: Ledgerly matches every bank transaction to its invoice or expense automatically, flagging only the few that need a human eye.

features.title: Live cash position
features.text: See your real cash balance, upcoming obligations, and runway at a glance — updated the moment money moves.

features.title: Invoice-to-ledger sync
features.text: Send an invoice and it lands in the ledger the moment it's paid. No re-keying, no missed entries, no double counting.

features.title: Tax-ready reports
features.text: P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements that are always current and exportable for your accountant in one click.

features.title: Expense capture
features.text: Snap a receipt and Ledgerly reads it, categorizes it, and attaches it to the right entry — so nothing slips through at tax time.

features.title: Accountant access
features.text: Give your accountant a read-only view or full access with a single invite. No more emailing spreadsheets back and forth.

settings.title: The books,
settings.intro: Whether you're a solo founder or a growing team, Ledgerly adapts to how you work — without forcing you into a rigid chart of accounts.

design.title: Simple single-entity books
design.text: One clean ledger for your freelance income and expenses, with automatic tax categorization and a one-click annual report.

design.title: Receipts on the go
design.text: Snap receipts from your phone and Ledgerly files them instantly — no shoebox, no lost deductions.

build.title: Multi-account reconciliation
build.text: Connect your business bank, credit cards, and payment processors. Ledgerly reconciles them all against one ledger.

build.title: Invoicing that books itself
build.text: Create and send invoices, and watch them post to the ledger automatically when paid — with late-payment reminders built in.

launch.title: Team roles & approvals
launch.text: Give your team controlled access with role-based permissions, so the right people see the right numbers.

launch.title: Accountant-ready exports
launch.text: Hand your accountant clean, GAAP-friendly exports and a read-only portal — no more spreadsheet archaeology.

settings.title: Straight answers,
settings.intro: The questions founders ask us most before they move their books to Ledgerly.

items.question: Is my financial data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Ledgerly uses bank-grade 256-bit encryption in transit and at rest, and we never sell or share your data. You can export everything and leave anytime.

items.question: Will it work with my accountant?
items.answer: Absolutely. Give your accountant a read-only portal or full access with one invite, and export clean, GAAP-friendly reports whenever they need them.

items.question: How does auto-reconciliation work?
items.answer: Ledgerly connects to your bank, cards, and payment processors, then matches every transaction to its invoice or expense automatically. Only the few that need a human decision get flagged for your review.

items.question: Can I import my existing books?
items.answer: Yes. Bring in your current spreadsheet or accounting export, and Ledgerly maps it to your new ledger so you start with a clean, complete history — not a blank page.
